name: Spondyloepimetaphyseal Dysplasia, Matrilin-3 Type

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and Genetic Diagnostic Criteria for SEMD Matrilin-3 Type

criteria.description: Presence of disproportionate short stature with short trunk and limb shortening
Radiographic evidence of spondyloepimetaphyseal dysplasia including vertebral flattening and metaphyseal irregularities
Identification of pathogenic variants in the MATN3 gene
Positive family history consistent with autosomal dominant inheritance

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of characteristic clinical and radiographic features plus confirmation of MATN3 mutation
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing is essential to confirm diagnosis and differentiate from other skeletal dysplasias.

searchTerms: short arms and legs with normal torso

imaging: Platyspondyly with flattened vertebral bodies on spine X-ray
Metaphyseal irregularities and epiphyseal dysplasia on long bone radiographs
Possible hip dysplasia on pelvic imaging
other: Family history consistent with autosomal dominant inheritance pattern

distinguishingFeatures: Earlier and more severe vertebral involvement
Predominantly epiphyseal involvement without significant vertebral changes

redFlags: Progressive neurological symptoms suggesting spinal cord compression
Severe respiratory compromise due to thoracic cage deformity
Atlantoaxial instability with risk of spinal cord injury
references: Superti-Furga A, Unger S. Nosology and classification of genetic skeletal disorders: 2019 revision. Am J Med Genet A. 2019.
Henderson S, et al. MATN3 mutations in spondyloepimetaphyseal dysplasia. Hum Mutat. 2009.
Orphanet: Spondyloepimetaphyseal dysplasia, matrilin-3 type. ORPHA:156728.
